units.source_text: 前斋宫身边的人，是侍女长、斋宫寮的女官之类的人，

en.t: The people around the former Ise priestess were attendants such as the chief lady-in-waiting and the women officials of the Saigu office,

units.source_text: 或者关系较深的亲王家的女儿等，都是富有教养的人。

en.t: or daughters from princely families with close ties to her, and they were all highly cultivated women.

units.source_text: 因此源氏公子想：“她有这优良环境，

en.t: Therefore Prince Genji thought, "With such an excellent environment around her,

units.source_text: 那么照我心中的打算，将来进入后宫，一定不会比别的妃嫔逊色。

en.t: if things go according to the plan I have in mind and she enters the imperial court in the future, she will surely not be inferior to any of the other consorts.

units.source_text: 但她的容貌如何，我总想看个清楚才好。”

en.t: But as for what she looks like, I would still like to see her clearly for myself."

units.source_text: 然而这恐怕不见得纯粹是清清白白的父母爱子之心吧？

en.t: Yet this was probably not simply the pure and innocent affection of a parent for a child, was it?

units.source_text: 源氏公子自己也知道自己的心变化不定，

en.t: Prince Genji himself also knew that his own heart was changeable,

units.source_text: 所以送她入后宫当女御的打算，对人秘而不宣。

en.t: so he kept secret from others his plan to send her into the palace as an imperial consort.

units.source_text: 他现在只管用尽心计为六条妃子营奠营斋，

en.t: For now, he devoted all his care to arranging memorial offerings and rites for the Rokujo lady,

units.source_text: 因此伺候前斋宫的人对他这种深情厚谊都很赞善。

en.t: and therefore the people serving the former Ise priestess all praised him for this deep kindness and devotion.
